columns.name: TM_REPROCESS_REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Primary Key column containing a random generated number.  This column is not updateable.

columns.name: TM_REC_GRP_ID
columns.description: Refers to TM_REC_GRP_ID in TM_REC_GRP

columns.name: TM_REC_GRP_VERSION
columns.description: Refers to TM_REC_GRP_VERSION in TM_REC_GRP

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: RESOURCE_ID
columns.description: The resource for which the time record group applies.

columns.name: TM_REC_GRP_STATUS
columns.description: TM_REC_GRP_STATUS

columns.name: START_TIME
columns.description: START_TIME

columns.name: AUTO_APPROVE
columns.description: Contains a (Y/N) value to specify if elegible for Auto Approval

columns.name: REPROCESS_REASON
columns.description: REPROCESS_REASON

columns.name: REQUIRES_MANUAL_PROCESSING
columns.description: Contains a (Y/N) value to specify if it requires manual processing.

columns.name: REPROCESS_REQUEST_TIME
columns.description: The time at which a request has been submitted for re-processing.

columns.name: REPROCESS_SOURCE
columns.description: The source Event/Ess Jod which has triggered request for re-processing

columns.name: REPROCESS_SOURCE_ID
columns.description: The Id for the Event/Ess Job which has triggered request for re-processing

columns.name: REPROCESS_REQUEST_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the request that has been submitted for reprocess

columns.name: REPROCESS_STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the Time RecordGroup (row)  that has been submitted for reprocess.

columns.name: RUN_START_TIME
columns.description: Start time for reprocessing run for the row

columns.name: RUN_END_TIME
columns.description: End time for reprocessing run for the row

columns.name: RUN_ERROR
columns.description: Stores error if any that is encountered during reprocessing.

columns.name: LATEST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this is the latest entry of the time record group (there will be a unique combination of TM_REC_GRP_ID and LATEST_FLAG).

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.
